description: Header file defining interfaces and data structures for RTCoA over WiFi thermostats, including thermostat state, modes, callbacks, and control functions.
external_methods: bool rtcoaWifiThermostatStartMonitoring(const char *macAddress, const char *ipAddress, RtcoaWifiThermostatStateChangedCallback, RtcoaWifiThermostatIpChangedCallback)

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatStartDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates discovery of RTCoA WiFi thermostats on the local network.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatStopDiscovery
methods.description: Stops the discovery process for RTCoA WiFi thermostats.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatStateGetState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified thermostat by IP address.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatGetModel
methods.description: Retrieves the model information of a specified thermostat.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatStateDestroyState
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a thermostat state object.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatStartMonitoring
methods.description: Begins monitoring a thermostat for state changes and IP changes.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatSetMode
methods.description: Sets the overall mode (off, heat, cool) of the thermostat.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatSetSimpleMode
methods.description: Enables or disables 'simple' mode on the thermostat.
